expectations.text: Uses qubrics-mcp-mailbox and qubrics-mcp for the requested local stdio commands without teaching old console executables.
expectations.evidence: The historical response teaches sendmux-mcp-mailbox and sendmux-mcp and says the renamed commands are not established.

expectations.text: Uses QUBRICS_API_KEY and the literal requested secret placeholder in mailbox-only Cursor JSON, explaining supported interpolation without exposing a credential.
expectations.evidence: Historical Cursor JSON uses sendmux-mcp-mailbox and SENDMUX_API_KEY, so it cannot configure the requested renamed source.

expectations.text: Documents QUBRICS environment names and retained SENDMUX compatibility fallbacks.
expectations.evidence: It documents QUBRICS_MCP_SURFACES before its SENDMUX_MCP_SURFACES fallback, though other examples remain legacy.

expectations.text: Preserves existing MCP runtime tool selectors and explains qubrics_ aliases without inventing replacement selectors.
expectations.evidence: It preserves runtime selector names but does not explain the candidate qubrics_ aliases.

expectations.text: Requires verification of candidate package publication and claims no launch, authentication or content access.
expectations.evidence: It requires actual package/console-script verification and explicitly reports no launch/authentication/content access.

limits: Offline source-instruction evaluation only. No runtime, publication, authentication or client-certification measurement.
